description: This file defines the ContentTop controller class within the Opencart.Catalog.Controller.Common namespace. It manages the display of content at the top of pages, determining layout ID based on route, loading associated modules and their configurations, and rendering the view with assembled data.

classes.name: ContentTop
classes.description: Controller class responsible for assembling and rendering the content top section of the page, including loading modules based on layout and route.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that loads layout modules, determines the correct layout ID based on route parameters, and returns the rendered view for the content top section.
